notes.title: The demo of Zerium War: Destiny has been updated! 🎉
notes.content:
Demo：Please go to the demo shop to download the latest content
Reserve Now：https://t.eegames.com/4jok1Pvz
Discord：https://discord.gg/AtNHusz6mW


Dear Players,
Thank you for your continued support and love for Zerium War: Destiny! Since the beginning of the year, we have released the demo pack of "Zerium War: Destiny", and we have received a lot of enthusiastic feedback, and today our production team has also updated the content of the demo pack!

What's new
1️⃣ Open skin replacement function:
Everyone complains that our existing protagonist is too ugly and has no eyes! In order to give everyone more freedom to express their individuality, we have added a new function to change character skins. Now, you can choose different characters to fight according to your preferences.

Function Optimization
1️⃣ Bullet Launch Position Optimization:
In this update, the position of bullet firing has been adjusted to ensure that the combat strike is more visually reasonable and the combat experience is smoother. (Special thanks to the player "Big Fish Drinking Coke" for their feedback)

2️⃣ Game Perspective Highly Optimized:
Many players have reported that the game perspective is uncomfortable, so we have adjusted the height and range of the game to make the game more horizontal. But I don't know if this feeling can make everyone comfortable, and I hope you can tell us how you feel after experiencing the new version! Thank you so much! (Special thanks to players for their feedback such as "Chic Xiaosa" and "Spring Breeze and Rain")

3️⃣ Viewing angle sensitivity optimization:
We've increased the sensitivity of the viewing angle, giving you more flexibility to adjust the viewing angle when operating, whether it's for quick steering or precise aiming. In the future, we will continue to pay attention to the player's operation experience! (Special thanks to players for their feedback on "Watching the Sea in the Rain")

BUG FIXES
1️⃣ Sprint stuck issue fixes:
Fixed a possible stuttering issue during a sprint to ensure a smooth sprint.

Follow-up Optimization Plan
Although we have only solved some of the problems reported by players this time, we also know that there are still many areas that need to be improved and improved, such as "the UI interface and scenes are rough and simple", "the characters are stiff", "the meat pigeon is not enough and feels bored", "music and sound effects are ghostly", etc., which may take a long period to completely improve.

But we have taken all your suggestions and opinions seriously! And actively discuss the optimization, and will gradually present it to you in the follow-up demo update, bringing you a better game experience ٩(˃̶͈̀௰˂̶͈́)و

Finally, our production team would like to say to you that we are always listening to the voices of players, and we really appreciate your feedback and suggestions, it is your valuable comments that make us continue to improve 🏃. Therefore, we hope that you will continue to give us valuable ideas and suggestions, whether it is gameplay, graphics, or anything else! We will all take it seriously and actively adopt it. 

Thank you again for your support and love for Zerium War: Destiny! We will continue to work hard to 💪 bring you a better gaming experience 🍀 


Demo update on March 6, 2025
—— Electronic Singularity Office

notes.title: Zerium War: Destiny Demo Now Available! Free to Play!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players! Our first independent game, Zerium War: Destiny, is now available as a demo! 

We welcome everyone to download and try it out. You can find the demo on the Steam store page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3427340/Zerium_War_Destiny_Demo/

Game Introduction
Zerium War: Destiny is a Roguelike RPG that blends science fiction with traditional cultivation elements. Players will take on the role of a guardian of the geocore base, navigating through waves of endless invaders. With unique auto-shooting skills and a rich array of strategic combinations, you will grow stronger and challenge the limits of fate. Every battle is a new adventure, and every choice can change your destiny!

Demo Highlights

 Smooth Auto-Shooting Gameplay: Easy to pick up and master, with a satisfying "mowing down" experience!
 Rich Roguelike Elements: Random buffs, card draws, and rare equipment drops provide a fresh experience every time. Feel the thrill of growth and challenge with each playthrough.
 Equipment Building Outside of Runs: Customize your loadout and create your own unique playstyle.
 Realistic Graphics: An immersive visual and auditory experience that transports you to a deep and stylistically diverse underground world.


Pre-Order Event
With the launch of the demo, our pre-order event has also begun! By pre-ordering now, you will receive exclusive rewards when the game is officially released. Be one of the first to experience the full game! 
Pre-order here: https://t.eegames.com/4jok1Pvz

Player Feedback
We welcome your feedback and criticism! If you have any suggestions or encounter any issues while playing, please feel free to leave a message on the Steam Community, our player Discord. We will carefully collect and optimize the game based on your input.

Discord：https://discord.gg/ENzanWsceU

Message from the Development Team
Dear players, we are Electronic Singularity, a team of passionate game creators. Zerium War: Destiny is our first project, and we have poured our hearts into it to bring you a unique gaming experience. Thank you for your support as we face destiny together and embark on this fantastic adventure!
